verdict.rationale: HubSpot's reporting pages describe revenue analytics reports, custom dashboards, and dozens of pre-built sales reports. Its CRM stores deal records. Together this suggests pipeline-based revenue reporting, but nothing in the evidence describes a forecasting tool. Missing for 10: any documentation of a revenue forecast feature, weighting of pipeline value by deal-stage probabilities, use of close dates in projections, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
